source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
In your Command phase, any number of your **CHAOS KNIGHTS** units may each attempt a Malefic Surge. Each one first takes a Leadership test, suffering D3 **mortal wounds** if it fails, and is then Empowered until your next Command phase begins.

An Empowered unit may use 1 of these Malefic Surge abilities, after which it stops being Empowered:

- **Unholy Hunger**: when one of its models makes a **Normal move**, **Advance move** or **Fall Back move**, it gets +3" Move until the phase ends.
- **Diabolic Power**: when you select the unit to shoot or fight, its models' weapons gain your choice of **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)** or **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)** until the phase ends.
- **Unnatural Fortitude**: when the unit is chosen as an attack's target, its models gain your choice of a 5+ invulnerable save or **[Feel No Pain 6+](vsdata:core-ability/feel-no-pain)** until the phase ends.

A token beside each Empowered unit, removed once it uses an ability, is recommended; clear unused tokens as your Command phase begins.
